why: RJ-X50, pending SR-7 (shared-raw): opens tiny-bayer.dng (a byte copy of SuiteImagingTests' raw fixture, written by TinyDNG: a 64 x 48 Bayer scene stored with Orientation 6, two highlight patches at 0.70 and 0.90 linear under a +1 stop baseline), pulls exposure down one stop and exports a PNG at full size. Assertion: the PNG is 48 x 64, upright, not the embedded preview's 24 x 32, within 3 levels of the reference, and its two highlight patches differ by more than 20 levels (an 8-bit decode clips both to white). The trap: the export is the preview's size, or the decode went through 8 bits so the highlights come back flat. Only macOS decodes RAW files (Linux refuses with the unavailable sentence), so platforms is [] until SR-7, which adds expected/tiny-bayer-ev-1.png and sets platforms to macos.
